# Extracta.ai

Extracta.ai is an AI-powered platform that automates data extraction from various document types, including PDFs, images, and text files, without requiring prior training.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/extracta-ai/.

## Actions

- **Create Extraction**: Initiate a new document extraction process.
- **Delete Extraction**: Delete an extraction process.
- **View Extraction** (read-only): Retrieve details of an existing extraction process.
